[[File:Nulodion chathead.png|left]]
'''Nulodion''' is the official [[Dwarf multicannon|Dwarf Cannon]] engineer and Weapons Development Chief of the [[Dwarven Black Guard]]. During the [[Dwarf Cannon]] [[quest]], he gives the player an [[ammo mould]] and [[Nulodion's notes]] to bring back to [[Captain Lawgof]]. Nulodion's [[Multicannon parts for sale]] is the only place that sells the parts of the [[dwarf multicannon]] (once the player has completed the [[Dwarf Cannon]] quest). The store also sells the cannon [[instruction manual]], and [[ammo mould]]s to make your own [[cannonball]]s. Ammo moulds are used in the [[Between a Rock...]] quest.

If your cannon decays or you log out while your cannon is set up you can talk to him, selecting the dialogue option "I've lost my cannon" will allow you to retrieve it free of charge. Nulodion is capable of recovering multiple cannons at once if the player has lost multiple cannons before talking with him. If you had [[Shattered cannon ornament kit]]s attached to your cannon, they will also be retrieved.

===Dialogue===
Through dialogue, Nulodion will sell all four dwarf multicannon parts as a set at a discounted price of 750,000 coins (compared to 802,500 coins if buying all four parts individually).
